footnote_text: Pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of July 28, 2026, by and among the Issuer, Viking ParentCo, Inc., ("Parent"), and Viking MergerCo, Inc. ("Merger Sub"), Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer, with the Issuer continuing as the surviving corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. || Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the merger, each outstanding share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of the Issuer was canceled and converted into the right to receive $55.00 in cash per share, without interest.
